turns.prompt_text: how can I change your output voice?
turns.response_html:
To change the voice I use to speak with you, you’ll need to adjust the settings within the Gemini app on your mobile device. Since I don't have a single "system" voice, you can pick the one that sounds best to you.

How to Change the Voice

  1. Open the Gemini app on your Android or iOS device.
  2. Tap your profile picture or initial in the top right corner.
  3. Go to Settings.
  4. Tap on Gemini Voice.
  5. Swipe through the different options to hear a preview of each voice.
  6. Once you find one you like, simply exit the menu, and that will be my new voice for all spoken responses and Gemini Live sessions.

A Note on Gemini Live

If you are using Gemini Live (the real-time, hands-free conversational mode), you can also access these settings quickly to ensure the tone matches the vibe of our conversation—whether you want something calm and soothing or energetic and bright.

Would you like me to help you find some of the other customization settings, like changing the theme or managing your activity?
